header.drawing_title: ADDITIONAL REINFORCEMENT AROUND THE OPENING AT THE INNER WALL AT STA: 0+314

classification.project_type: infrastructure (tunnel/culvert or buried structure with wall openings, station-referenced)
classification.notes: Elevation of an inner wall panel at STA: 0+314 showing two rectangular openings with additional diagonal reinforcement (4 Y25) around each, vertical bars (12 Y32) at three locations, and Y16/Y18-150 stirrup/tie bars in the pier between openings. No overall wall height/length dimension is given, only opening dimensions and rebar callouts.

opening_diagonal_bar_count_total.description: Total count of diagonal Y25 reinforcement bars placed around the wall openings (labelled '4 Y25' at 4 locations around each opening corner band).

vertical_bar_count_total.description: Total count of vertical Y32 reinforcement bars shown at the three '12 Y32' callout locations along the wall base.

opening_area_total.description: Total blockout/formwork area of the two rectangular wall openings, each dimensioned 3000mm x 1500mm.

pier_tie_bar_count.description: Count of Y16/Y18-150 tie/stirrup bars in the wall pier between the two openings, derived from spacing over the visible tie zone height.
